text:
jordan: Hey team — new starter hitting 403 on the starter-kit first call from their Mac (M1, macOS Ventura). Copy/pasted the env var and ran the curl example, but getting 403.

maria: which curl exactly?

jordan: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.com/v1/health
```
response shows 403 and body: 'workspace billing_required'.

devex-bot: New workspace created for jordan@example.com (ws_0123) — free credits applied (expires in 14 days).

sam: 403 with "billing_required" usually means the workspace isn't fully provisioned or billing flag didn't flip. But also seen when requests are routed to a different host and token isn't valid there.

jordan: They confirmed they joined the invite link. Console shows credits present, but the workspace status is "needs billing" (ui). Weird.

kate: On macs with Docker + corporate VPN we sometimes hit a DNS rewrite bug: internal resolver returns a private IP for api.redwood.com -> requests land on our internal tenant gateway which rejects the token. Can you `dig api.redwood.com` or `scutil --dns` on the machine?

jordan: ran `scutil --dns` — there is a search domain from the VPN. dig returns 10.10.10.5 (internal) instead of public IP.

maria: yep that explains it. Quick hack: `curl --resolve api.redwood.com:443:34.212.12.1 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.com/v1/health` should hit the public endpoint and confirm token is valid.

jordan: tried that, got 200, health OK. So token/credits were fine — just DNS tricking the call.

sam: For the Node starter, setting the explicit base helps: `REDWOOD_API_BASE=https://api.redwood.com` or export `NO_PROXY=api.redwood.com` if corporate proxy is the issue.

jordan: Setting REDWOOD_API_BASE fixed the sample app too. First successful call logged :)

maria: Thanks for debugging. Action items: 1) add a short note to devex FAQ about macOS + VPN/Docker DNS causing 403 on quickstart; 2) add CLI troubleshoot command to check workspace/billing (`rw whoami` and `rw billing status`).

alex: I'll add the doc and a tiny troubleshooting section to the starter-kit README with the `--resolve` example and the env var fix. Will include a note about `rw whoami` and the console path to billing.

kate: Also let's add a one-liner in the onboarding checklist for new hires: "If first call 403, try network DNS or proxy workaround before opening infra ticket." :thumbsup:

jordan: awesome, thanks all — closing the loop here. saved the workaround in the Confluence quickstart page.
